---- MODULE ivy_examples_alternating_bit_protocol ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_alternating_bit_protocolDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL AgentSeq == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems
AgentTypeOK ==
  /\ sender_array \in [Nat -> Value]
  /\ receiver_array \in [Nat -> Value]
  /\ sender_i \in Nat
  /\ sender_gen_i \in Nat
  /\ receiver_i \in Nat
  /\ sender_bit \in BOOLEAN
  /\ receiver_bit \in BOOLEAN
  /\ data_chan \in Seq([value : DataValue, bit : BOOLEAN])
  /\ ack_chan \in Seq(BOOLEAN)
AgentSAInv ==
  /\ sender_i \in Nat
  /\ sender_gen_i \in Nat
  /\ sender_i <= sender_gen_i
  /\ \A j \in Nat : (j < sender_gen_i => sender_array[j] \in DataValue)
  /\ \A j \in Nat : (j >= sender_gen_i => sender_array[j] = Bot)
AgentRAInv ==
  /\ receiver_i \in Nat
  /\ receiver_i <= sender_gen_i
  /\ \A j \in Nat : (j < receiver_i => receiver_array[j] = sender_array[j] /\ receiver_array[j] \in DataValue)
  /\ \A j \in Nat : (j >= receiver_i => receiver_array[j] = Bot)
AgentCountInv ==
  /\ sender_i <= receiver_i
  /\ receiver_i <= sender_i + 1
  /\ ((sender_i = receiver_i) <=> (sender_bit = receiver_bit))
AgentDataNew ==
  \A k \in 1..Len(data_chan) : (data_chan[k].bit = sender_bit => data_chan[k].value = sender_array[sender_i])
AgentDataOld ==
  \A k \in 1..Len(data_chan) : (data_chan[k].bit # sender_bit => sender_i # 0 /\ data_chan[k].value = sender_array[sender_i - 1] /\ data_chan[k].bit = ~sender_bit)
AgentDataOrder ==
  \A i, j \in 1..Len(data_chan) : ((i < j /\ data_chan[i].bit = sender_bit) => data_chan[j].bit = sender_bit)
AgentDataAllNew ==
  (receiver_i = sender_i + 1) => (\A k \in 1..Len(data_chan) : data_chan[k].bit = sender_bit)
AgentAckOrder ==
  \A i, j \in 1..Len(ack_chan) : ((i < j /\ ack_chan[i] = sender_bit) => ack_chan[j] = sender_bit)
AgentAckAllOld ==
  (sender_i = receiver_i) => (\A k \in 1..Len(ack_chan) : ack_chan[k] # sender_bit)
AgentInd == AgentTypeOK /\ AgentSAInv /\ AgentRAInv /\ AgentCountInv /\ AgentDataNew /\ AgentDataOld /\ AgentDataOrder /\ AgentDataAllNew /\ AgentAckOrder /\ AgentAckAllOld
LEMMA AgentTailBool ==
  ASSUME NEW sb \in BOOLEAN, NEW s \in Seq(BOOLEAN),
         \A i, j \in 1..Len(s) : ((i < j /\ s[i] = sb) => s[j] = sb),
         s # <<>>
  PROVE \A i, j \in 1..Len(Tail(s)) : ((i < j /\ Tail(s)[i] = sb) => Tail(s)[j] = sb)
<1>1. ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(Tail(s)), NEW j \in 1..Len(Tail(s))
      PROVE (i < j /\ Tail(s)[i] = sb => Tail(s)[j] = sb)
  <2>1. ASSUME i < j, Tail(s)[i] = sb
        PROVE Tail(s)[j] = sb
    <3>1. Len(Tail(s)) = Len(s) - 1 /\ Tail(s) \in Seq(BOOLEAN)
      BY <1>1, AgentSeq!HeadTailProperties
    <3>2. i+1 \in 1..Len(s) /\ j+1 \in 1..Len(s) /\ i+1 < j+1
      BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>1, AgentSeq!LenProperties
    <3>3. Tail(s)[i] = s[i+1] /\ Tail(s)[j] = s[j+1]
      BY <1>1, AgentSeq!HeadTailProperties
    <3>4. s[i+1] = sb
      BY <2>1, <3>3
    <3>5. s[j+1] = sb
      BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>2, <3>4
    <3>6. QED
      BY <3>3, <3>5
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1
LEMMA AgentTailData ==
  ASSUME NEW sb \in BOOLEAN, NEW s \in Seq([value : DataValue, bit : BOOLEAN]),
         \A i, j \in 1..Len(s) : ((i < j /\ s[i].bit = sb) => s[j].bit = sb),
         s # <<>>
  PROVE \A i, j \in 1..Len(Tail(s)) : ((i < j /\ Tail(s)[i].bit = sb) => Tail(s)[j].bit = sb)
<1>1. ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(Tail(s)), NEW j \in 1..Len(Tail(s))
      PROVE (i < j /\ Tail(s)[i].bit = sb => Tail(s)[j].bit = sb)
  <2>1. ASSUME i < j, Tail(s)[i].bit = sb
        PROVE Tail(s)[j].bit = sb
    <3>1. Len(Tail(s)) = Len(s) - 1 /\ Tail(s) \in Seq([value : DataValue, bit : BOOLEAN])
      BY <1>1, AgentSeq!HeadTailProperties DEF DataValue
    <3>2. i+1 \in 1..Len(s) /\ j+1 \in 1..Len(s) /\ i+1 < j+1
      BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>1, AgentSeq!LenProperties
    <3>3. Tail(s)[i] = s[i+1] /\ Tail(s)[j] = s[j+1]
      BY <1>1, AgentSeq!HeadTailProperties
    <3>4. s[i+1].bit = sb
      BY <2>1, <3>3
    <3>5. s[j+1].bit = sb
      BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>2, <3>4
    <3>6. QED
      BY <3>3, <3>5
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1
LEMMA AgentRemBool ==
  ASSUME NEW sb \in BOOLEAN, NEW s \in Seq(BOOLEAN), NEW r \in 1..Len(s),
         \A i, j \in 1..Len(s) : ((i < j /\ s[i] = sb) => s[j] = sb)
  PROVE \A i, j \in 1..Len(RemoveAt(s, r)) : ((i < j /\ RemoveAt(s, r)[i] = sb) => RemoveAt(s, r)[j] = sb)
<1>1. ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(RemoveAt(s, r)), NEW j \in 1..Len(RemoveAt(s, r))
      PROVE (i < j /\ RemoveAt(s, r)[i] = sb => RemoveAt(s, r)[j] = sb)
  <2>1. ASSUME i < j, RemoveAt(s, r)[i] = sb
        PROVE RemoveAt(s, r)[j] = sb
    <3>1. Len(RemoveAt(s, r)) = Len(s) - 1
      BY <1>1 DEF RemoveAt
    <3>2. RemoveAt(s, r)[i] = (IF i < r THEN s[i] ELSE s[i+1])
         /\ RemoveAt(s, r)[j] = (IF j < r THEN s[j] ELSE s[j+1])
      BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>1 DEF RemoveAt
    <3>3. i \in 1..(Len(s)-1) /\ j \in 1..(Len(s)-1)
      BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>1
    <3>4. CASE i < r /\ j < r
      <4>1. s[i] = sb
        BY <2>1, <3>2, <3>4
      <4>2. s[j] = sb
        BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>3, <3>4, <4>1
      <4>3. QED
        BY <3>2, <3>4, <4>2
    <3>5. CASE i < r /\ j >= r
      <4>1. s[i] = sb
        BY <2>1, <3>2, <3>5
      <4>2. i < j+1 /\ s[i] = sb
        BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>3, <3>5, <4>1
      <4>3. s[j+1] = sb
        BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>3, <3>5, <4>2
      <4>4. QED
        BY <3>2, <3>5, <4>3
    <3>6. CASE i >= r /\ j >= r
      <4>1. s[i+1] = sb
        BY <2>1, <3>2, <3>6
      <4>2. i+1 < j+1 /\ s[i+1] = sb
        BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>3, <3>6, <4>1
      <4>3. s[j+1] = sb
        BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>3, <3>6, <4>2
      <4>4. QED
        BY <3>2, <3>6, <4>3
    <3>7. CASE i >= r /\ j < r
      <4>1. j <= i
        BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>3, <3>7
      <4>2. QED
        BY <1>1, <2>1, <4>1
    <3>8. QED
      BY <3>4, <3>5, <3>6, <3>7
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1
LEMMA AgentRemData ==
  ASSUME NEW sb \in BOOLEAN, NEW s \in Seq([value : DataValue, bit : BOOLEAN]), NEW r \in 1..Len(s),
         \A i, j \in 1..Len(s) : ((i < j /\ s[i].bit = sb) => s[j].bit = sb)
  PROVE \A i, j \in 1..Len(RemoveAt(s, r)) : ((i < j /\ RemoveAt(s, r)[i].bit = sb) => RemoveAt(s, r)[j].bit = sb)
<1>1. ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(RemoveAt(s, r)), NEW j \in 1..Len(RemoveAt(s, r))
      PROVE (i < j /\ RemoveAt(s, r)[i].bit = sb => RemoveAt(s, r)[j].bit = sb)
  <2>1. ASSUME i < j, RemoveAt(s, r)[i].bit = sb
        PROVE RemoveAt(s, r)[j].bit = sb
    <3>1. Len(RemoveAt(s, r)) = Len(s) - 1
      BY <1>1 DEF RemoveAt
    <3>2. RemoveAt(s, r)[i] = (IF i < r THEN s[i] ELSE s[i+1])
         /\ RemoveAt(s, r)[j] = (IF j < r THEN s[j] ELSE s[j+1])
      BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>1 DEF RemoveAt
    <3>3. i \in 1..(Len(s)-1) /\ j \in 1..(Len(s)-1)
      BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>1
    <3>4. CASE i < r /\ j < r
      <4>1. s[i].bit = sb
        BY <2>1, <3>2, <3>4
      <4>2. s[j].bit = sb
        BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>3, <3>4, <4>1
      <4>3. QED
        BY <3>2, <3>4, <4>2
    <3>5. CASE i < r /\ j >= r
      <4>1. s[i].bit = sb
        BY <2>1, <3>2, <3>5
      <4>2. i < j+1 /\ s[i].bit = sb
        BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>3, <3>5, <4>1
      <4>3. s[j+1].bit = sb
        BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>3, <3>5, <4>2
      <4>4. QED
        BY <3>2, <3>5, <4>3
    <3>6. CASE i >= r /\ j >= r
      <4>1. s[i+1].bit = sb
        BY <2>1, <3>2, <3>6
      <4>2. i+1 < j+1 /\ s[i+1].bit = sb
        BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>3, <3>6, <4>1
      <4>3. s[j+1].bit = sb
        BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>3, <3>6, <4>2
      <4>4. QED
        BY <3>2, <3>6, <4>3
    <3>7. CASE i >= r /\ j < r
      <4>1. j <= i
        BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>3, <3>7
      <4>2. QED
        BY <1>1, <2>1, <4>1
    <3>8. QED
      BY <3>4, <3>5, <3>6, <3>7
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Safety == SafetySpec => []ReceiverValuesFromSender
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_alternating_bit_protocol/ivy_examples_alternating_bit_protocol_Safety.tla
PROOF
<1>1. Init => AgentInd
  BY ValueAssumption DEF Init, AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue
<1>2. AgentInd /\ [Next]_vars => AgentInd'
  <2>1. AgentInd /\ Next => AgentInd'
    <3>1. AgentInd /\ (\E v \in DataValue : GenerateData(v)) => AgentInd'
      BY ValueAssumption DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, GenerateData, vars
    <3>2. AgentInd /\ SenderSendData => AgentInd'
      BY ValueAssumption DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, SenderSendData, vars
    <3>3. AgentInd /\ SenderReceiveAck => AgentInd'
      BY ValueAssumption, AgentTailBool DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, SenderReceiveAck, vars
    <3>4. AgentInd /\ ReceiverReceiveData => AgentInd'
      BY ValueAssumption, AgentTailData DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, ReceiverReceiveData, vars
    <3>5. AgentInd /\ ReceiverSendAck => AgentInd'
      BY ValueAssumption DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, ReceiverSendAck, vars
    <3>6. AgentInd /\ (\E i \in 1..Len(data_chan) : DataMsgDrop(i)) => AgentInd'
      <4>1. AgentInd /\ (\E i \in 1..Len(data_chan) : DataMsgDrop(i)) => AgentTypeOK'
        BY ValueAssumption DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, DataMsgDrop, RemoveAt, vars
      <4>2. AgentInd /\ (\E i \in 1..Len(data_chan) : DataMsgDrop(i)) => AgentSAInv'
        BY ValueAssumption DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, DataMsgDrop, RemoveAt, vars
      <4>3. AgentInd /\ (\E i \in 1..Len(data_chan) : DataMsgDrop(i)) => AgentRAInv'
        BY ValueAssumption DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, DataMsgDrop, RemoveAt, vars
      <4>4. AgentInd /\ (\E i \in 1..Len(data_chan) : DataMsgDrop(i)) => AgentCountInv'
        BY ValueAssumption DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, DataMsgDrop, RemoveAt, vars
      <4>5. AgentInd /\ (\E i \in 1..Len(data_chan) : DataMsgDrop(i)) => AgentDataNew'
        BY ValueAssumption DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, DataMsgDrop, RemoveAt, vars
      <4>6. AgentInd /\ (\E i \in 1..Len(data_chan) : DataMsgDrop(i)) => AgentDataOld'
        BY ValueAssumption DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, DataMsgDrop, RemoveAt, vars
      <4>7. AgentInd /\ (\E i \in 1..Len(data_chan) : DataMsgDrop(i)) => AgentDataOrder'
        BY ValueAssumption, AgentRemData DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, DataMsgDrop, RemoveAt, vars
      <4>8. AgentInd /\ (\E i \in 1..Len(data_chan) : DataMsgDrop(i)) => AgentDataAllNew'
        BY ValueAssumption DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, DataMsgDrop, RemoveAt, vars
      <4>9. AgentInd /\ (\E i \in 1..Len(data_chan) : DataMsgDrop(i)) => AgentAckOrder'
        BY ValueAssumption DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, DataMsgDrop, RemoveAt, vars
      <4>10. AgentInd /\ (\E i \in 1..Len(data_chan) : DataMsgDrop(i)) => AgentAckAllOld'
        BY ValueAssumption DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, DataMsgDrop, RemoveAt, vars
      <4>11. QED
        BY <4>1, <4>2, <4>3, <4>4, <4>5, <4>6, <4>7, <4>8, <4>9, <4>10 DEF AgentInd
    <3>7. AgentInd /\ (\E i \in 1..Len(ack_chan) : AckMsgDrop(i)) => AgentInd'
      BY ValueAssumption, AgentRemBool DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, AckMsgDrop, RemoveAt, vars
    <3>8. QED
      BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, <3>5, <3>6, <3>7 DEF Next
  <2>2. AgentInd /\ UNCHANGED vars => AgentInd'
    BY DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, vars
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>3. AgentInd => ReceiverValuesFromSender
  BY ValueAssumption DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentSAInv, AgentRAInv, AgentCountInv, AgentDataNew, AgentDataOld, AgentDataOrder, AgentDataAllNew, AgentAckOrder, AgentAckAllOld, DataValue, ReceiverValuesFromSender
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF SafetySpec, Init, Next, vars, AgentInd, ReceiverValuesFromSender
\* END AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_alternating_bit_protocol/ivy_examples_alternating_bit_protocol_Safety.tla

THEOREM Liveness == Spec => DataDelivery
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_alternating_bit_protocol/ivy_examples_alternating_bit_protocol_Liveness.tla
PROOF
<1>1. Spec => []ReceiverValuesFromSender
  BY Safety DEF Spec, SafetySpec
<1>2. Spec => DataDelivery
  BY <1>1, PTL DEF Spec, DataDelivery, ReceiverValuesFromSender
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>2
\* END AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_alternating_bit_protocol/ivy_examples_alternating_bit_protocol_Liveness.tla
====
